title_en: At Mosaic of Tirana, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Location!!
description_en: At Mozaik i Tirana, on Sander Prosi street, Super Apartment 1+1 with perfect location is for sale!!! The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of an existing building with an actual area of ​​54 m2 and a certified area of ​​32 m2 and is organized in a spacious corridor that distributes through the other rooms, starting with the living room together with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom with a window. The orientation is from the South, which means that there is natural light during most of the day. The area where it is located is quite preferred both for residence and for investment, being very close to the center and the rental values ​​in this area are high. It has every possible facility such as nurseries, kindergartens, schools and any other service. The environment has recently been invested: parquet flooring, plumbing and electrical installations, doors, windows, etc... The apartment has proper mortgage documentation.
